_doc: Byte copies of hermes-home files (card t_29403e19). Never edit the copies; re-vendor and update this pin. tests/hermes_cli/test_fleet_placement_vendored.py checks each sha256 and fails once vendored_at is older than max_age_days. Fork-side differences live in __init__.py (the state root), never in a copy.
source_note: t_77aa2e0e: all five files re-vendored as ONE set from hermes-home main f994a5ed39 (after #11416 4107248b1, FWA B5-P3: the var/placement/exclusions.json read, read_exclusions and EXCLUSIONS_REL are gone, exclusions_path is accepted and ignored; kinds.json pause switches and power_policy added). No subset is coherent: placement calls admission.ceilings and admission_demand.root_directory. placement.py, admission.py, work_estimate.py and alloc_client.py are byte-equal to the fleet_admission 1.0.2 wheel (fleet-ops-scripts ci-runners/src/wheels, sha256 33cb576ea37e7155..., source hermes-home@479fb293); admission_demand.py is main's, newer than the wheel's. The fork cannot depend on that private wheel, so it re-vendors and pins. RUNTIME PRECONDITION (#9789): every ledger/demand/protected-marker write now needs PLACEMENT_ROOT_RECEIPT naming an operator-provisioned receipt for the kanban root, in the dispatcher's environment. load_lines.py, busy_basis.py, fwa.py and fwa_readers.py are not vendored: placement imports each late under ImportError (fleet default line, cpu_busy basis, no fwa hold read); the kanban pause gate reads fwa holds in kanban_pause_hold.
